items.title: The epsilon behavioural distance is the greatest fixed point of the Levy-Prokhorov lifted transition operator
items.author: Josée Desharnais; Ana Sokolova
items.source_version: Official published CSL2026.26 CC BY4.0 HTML/PDF Proposition15, full relevant AppendixA sections1--4 and original Sections2--3, retrieved2026-10-14; same-work aliasarxiv2507.10732
items.difficulty_reason: The authors identify the relational epsilon-distance with a fixed point of the lifted LP transition functional by constructing and extending maximal epsilon-bisimulations, comparing relation images with strict metric neighborhoods, and introducing a larger gamma to handle open-ball boundaries before taking infima. The full quantifier/inf-sup argument and prefixpoint-to-bisimulation/bound construction remain. This non-routine relation-to-metric coalgebraic characterization supports H2 as one fixed-point result; monotonicity/functor/unit lemmas are support or adjacent context, not separate counts.
